use_case_summary: Atelier CodeWorks builds an IDE copilot plugin that needs deterministic low-latency completions (streaming) and per-repo model/version pinning. They require dedicated GPU pools during peak developer hours with burst capacity for release sprints; VPC deployment with KMS and audit logging is mandatory. Goal: reduce per-completion cost via batching/caching while keeping developer-facing latency under 50ms p99 for short completions.
